title: Massive Activations Confound Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.13548v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are commonly evaluated by variance explained and ablation damage. We show how massive activations undermine both evaluations, and propose a correction. Massive activations cause up to 99.9% of activation variance to lie along the first principal component (PC1). Because the PC1 component has no unique sparse decomposition, each SAE run rebuilds it from a different set of features. These features dominate importance rankings: an average of 47 of the 50 most important features are unmatched in a separate run, compared with about 27 of a random 50. A dictionary can also report 99.96% of variance explained while leaving 33% of the variance outside PC1 unexplained. We bypass PC1 by training the SAE on activations with PC1 removed, then adding PC1 to the reconstruction. In affected models, the top-50 feature sharing rate rises from 4-39.5% to 73-99.5%. At the same TopK sparsity, the resulting SAE degrades the model

translated_title: 巨大激活混淆稀疏自编码器
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）通常通过方差解释率和消融损伤来进行评估。我们展示了巨大激活如何破坏这两种评估，并提出了一种修正方法。巨大激活会导致高达99.9%的激活方差集中在第一主成分（PC1）方向上。由于PC1分量没有唯一的稀疏分解，每次SAE运行都会用一组不同的特征来重建它。这些特征主导了重要性排名：在50个最重要的特征中，平均有47个在另一次独立运行中无法匹配，相比之下随机选取的50个特征中约有27个无法匹配。此外，一个字典可以报告99.96%的方差解释率，而与此同时PC1之外仍有33%的方差未被解释。我们通过在去除了PC1的激活上训练SAE、再将PC1加回重建结果中，从而绕过PC1。在受影响的模型中，前50个特征的共享率从4–39.5%提升至73–99.5%。在相同的TopK稀疏度下，由此得到的SAE会降低模型性能……
tldr: 该论文发现模型中的巨大激活使高达99.9%的激活方差集中于第一主成分（PC1），导致稀疏自编码器的评估指标失真、重要特征在不同运行间无法复现，并提出在去除PC1的激活上训练SAE、再将PC1加回重建结果的修正方法，将前50个特征的共享率从4–39.5%大幅提升至73–99.5%。
en_tdlr: Massive activations concentrate up to 99.9% of variance in the first principal component, confounding SAE evaluations and making top features irreproducible across runs; the proposed fix—training SAEs on activations with PC1 removed and adding PC1 back to the reconstruction—raises the top-50 feature sharing rate from 4–39.5% to 73–99.5%.
